description:
PROPOSAL
GROUND FLOOR
The proposal involves extending the property into the rear garden by approximately 3 metres to create additional ground-floor living/kitchen space. The existing side extension will be demolished and replaced with a new, contemporary
open-plan kitchen and dining area, designed to improve flow, functionality, and connection to the garden. The new space will be naturally lit by a generously sized rooflight, bringing daylight deep into the plan and enhancing the sense of
openness.
Internally, it is proposed to open up the front room into the existing middle room to form a more flexible, interconnected living area that can be used as a library or study, while still retaining a quieter character towards the front of the house.
The ground-floor layout will also be reconfigured to accommodate a new WC and a separate utility room, improving day-to-day practicality and storage, and allowing the main living spaces to remain uncluttered.
Overall, the works aim to modernise the layout, improve natural light and circulation, and create a more cohesive and family-friendly ground-floor arrangement while respecting the scale and character of the existing property.
FIRST FLOOR
The existing WC and bathroom will be removed as part of a wider reconfiguration of the internal layout. The small front room will be converted into a new, well-proportioned bathroom, allowing for improved layout efficiency and upgraded
sanitary provision.
At the rear of the property, the existing internal partitions will be removed to rationalise the plan and create a larger, more functional bedroom. This reconfiguration will improve proportions, flexibility, and natural light, resulting in a more
comfortable and usable private space.
Overall, the proposed alterations aim to optimise the internal arrangement, improve spatial quality, and better respond to the occupants’ needs, while making efficient use of the existing building footprint.
LOFT
The existing kitchen will be removed, and the space repurposed to form a new master bedroom, providing a generous and well-located principal sleeping space within the property.
